mapper.sql: l.id, l.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, l.project_id, p.project_name, l.source_channel, l.lead_status, l.lead_score, l.owner_id, u.username AS owner_username, l.next_followup_at, l.source_type, l.source_url, l.source_title, l.created_at, l.updated_at
FROM crm_lead l JOIN ent_enterprise e ON l.enterprise_id = e.id LEFT JOIN crm_project p ON l.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON l.owner_id = u.id

where.if: AND (e.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR p.project_name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

AND (l.lead_status NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST') AND l.next_followup_at IS NOT NULL AND (
l.next_followup_at < NOW()
l.next_followup_at >= NOW() AND l.next_followup_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY
l.next_followup_at >= NOW() AND l.next_followup_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY
1 = 0
))

mapper.select: SELECT id, source_url, source_title FROM crm_lead WHERE source_url_hash = #{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_lead (enterprise_id, project_id, source_channel, lead_status, lead_score, owner_id, next_followup_at, created_by) VALUES (#{enterprise}, #{project}, #{source}, #{status}, #{score}, #{owner}, #{nextFollowup}, #{actor})

INSERT INTO crm_lead (enterprise_id, project_id, source_channel, lead_status, owner_id, next_followup_at, created_by, source_type, source_url, source_url_hash, source_title) VALUES (#{enterprise}, #{project}, #{source}, 'NEW', #{owner}, #{nextFollowup}, #{actor}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceHash}, #{sourceTitle})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_lead SET lead_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_followup WHERE lead_id = #{id}
mapper.sql: f.id, f.lead_id, f.contact_id, c.name AS contact_name, f.followup_type, f.content, f.result, f.next_action, f.next_followup_at, f.created_by, u.username AS created_by_username, f.created_at
FROM crm_followup f JOIN crm_lead l ON f.lead_id = l.id LEFT JOIN crm_contact c ON f.contact_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.created_by = u.id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM crm_contact WHERE id = #{contact} AND enterprise_id = #{enterprise} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_followup (lead_id, contact_id, followup_type, content, result, next_action, next_followup_at, created_by) VALUES (#{lead}, #{contact}, #{type}, #{content}, #{result}, #{action}, #{nextFollowup}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_lead SET next_followup_at = #{nextFollowup} WHERE id = #{id}
